verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a self-hostable media relay, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents any retention window, cache-expiry setting, or deletion control. Self-hosting, end-to-end encryption, and a community-built S3 archiver are adjacent features or user-side arrangements, not documented retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
